scripts.build:all-services: echo 🏗️ Building all microservices... && npm run build:api-gateway && npm run build:auth && npm run build:gig && npm run build:user && echo ✅ All services built successfully!
scripts.install:services: cd api-gateway && npm install && cd ../services/auth-service && npm install && cd ../gig-service && npm install && cd ../user-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install && cd ../clan-service && npm install && cd ../credit-service && npm install && cd ../reputation-service && npm install && cd ../social-media-service && npm install && cd ../websocket-gateway && npm install && cd ../work-history-service && npm install
scripts.start:all: npm run start:gateway & npm run start:auth & npm run start:gig & npm run start:user
scripts.lint: npm run lint:auth && npm run lint:gig && npm run lint:user && npm run lint:gateway
scripts.lint:gig: cd services/gig-service && echo 'No linting configured for gig-service'
